falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 77% bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower lows; this would signal the 'bottom' call was premature and the structure was not corrective but rather a failed breakdown

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained sub-12 VIX would contradict the elevated fear regime implied by the bottom_2024_aug analog (which featured VIX spikes above 25); this would prove complacency, not capitulation, and invalidate the bottoming thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.50% and holds above it for 2 consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A renewed bond selloff to new cycle highs would signal the disinflationary/recessionary conditions that produced the August 2024 bottom are absent; this would falsify the macro regime match and show the current environment is expansionary, not corrective

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
